description: This file defines a SpinLock class for mutual exclusion, including lock, try-lock, and unlock methods, as well as related classes and functions for profiling and testing. It is part of the Abseil C++ library's internal base implementation.

classes.name: SpinLock
classes.description: A mutual exclusion lock designed for internal use, supporting async signal safety and cooperative scheduling.

classes.name: SpinLockHolder
classes.description: A RAII helper class that acquires a SpinLock on construction and releases it on destruction.

methods.name: SpinLock()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the lock in a cooperative mode.

methods.name: explicit SpinLock(base_internal::SchedulingMode mode)
methods.description: Constructor allowing non-cooperative mode for internal thread scheduler use.

methods.name: constexpr SpinLock(absl::ConstInitType, base_internal::SchedulingMode mode)
methods.description: Constructor for global SpinLock instances with optional cooperative scheduling.

methods.name: void Lock()
methods.description: Acquire the spinlock, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: bool TryLock()
methods.description: Attempt to acquire the lock without blocking; returns true if successful.

methods.name: bool IsHeld() const
methods.description: Check if the lock is currently held.

methods.name: void AssertHeld() const
methods.description: Assert that the current thread holds the lock.
